name: 04769 · Presque Isle, ME
findings: ZIP 04769 (Presque Isle) has 39 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 04769 (Presque Isle) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 04769 (Presque Isle) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 58% of the typical level).
